recipes.name: A5 Wagyu Roti Don inspired by Food Wars!
ingredients: 1 A5 Miyazaki Wagyu ribeye steak, trimmed into thin strips
instructions: For Show-Accurate Inspiration:
Preheat oven to 150° C.
Trim any excess fat from the ribeye and divide it into two equal parts. Set it aside to be sliced thinly after cooking. Season both sides with salt. - 1 A5 Wagyu Ribeye - salt

Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat until ripping hot (it should almost be smoking). Place the steak directly in the pan with no oil; the rendered fat from the steak will serve as cooking oil. - 1 A5 Wagyu Ribeye
Sear the steak for about 2 minutes per side until golden-brown on all sides. Remove from the pan and set aside. Clean the pan and save the rendered beef tallow for later use.

Return the clean pan to medium heat. Add unsalted butter, and once it has melted, return the steak to the pan. Baste the steak by spooning the butter continuously over the meat for about 1 minute. - 4 tbsp unsalted butter (for basting) - 1 A5 Wagyu Ribeye

Transfer the steak to a wire cooling rack set over a baking tray. Insert a meat thermometer into the thickest part of the steak. Reserve the butter and beef tallow left in the pan for the garlic rice.
Bake the steak in the preheated oven until it reaches an internal temperature of 65°C (150°F), about 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow the steak to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
For the Garlic Rice
In a wok or large skillet, melt the reserved beef tallow and butter over medium heat. - 3 tbsp beef tallow and butter
Add the sliced garlic and cook until golden brown and fragrant, about 2-3 minutes. - 4 cloves of garlic thinly sliced
A the day-old rice to the wok, tossing to coat each grain in the garlic-infused fat. Stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes until the rice is heated through. - 3 cups day old rice
Season with salt to taste, and stir in the minced parsley. Set aside. - salt - ⅓ cup fresh parsley finely minced
For the Assembly
After the steak has rested, slice it thinly against the grain. Fan the slices out in a rose pattern on top of the garlic rice. - For the Beef - For the Garlic Rice
Serve immediately while hot.
For Alvin's Version:
Season the strips of Miyazaki Wagyu generously with Kosher salt. - 1 A5 Miyazaki Wagyu ribeye steak trimmed into thin strips - Kosher salt

Heat the skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the Wagyu in its own fat without adding any extra oil. Aim for a nice golden-brown crust. Cook the steak until it reaches an internal temperature of 49° C (medium-rare). Remove from the pan and let it rest. - 1 A5 Miyazaki Wagyu ribeye steak trimmed into thin strips
For the Garlic Rice
In a wok over medium heat, melt the beef tallow and butter. - 3 tbsp beef tallow and butter
Add the sliced garlic and cook until golden brown. - 4 cloves of garlic thinly sliced
Once the garlic is golden brown, add the day-old rice and toss in the wok, ensuring every grain is coated with the fat. - 3 cups day old rice
Season with salt to taste, then stir in the minced parsley. Set aside. - salt - ⅓ cup fresh parsley finely minced
For the Assembly
Slice the rested steak thinly and arrange the pieces in a rose-like pattern on top of the garlic rice. - For the Beef - For the Garlic Rice
Serve immediately.
